sources.title: PDF Truthguard: An AI-Based Multimodal Framework for Detecting and ...
sources.snippet: This research paper proposes TruthGuard, an AI-powered multimodal misinformation detection framework that integrates Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and image verification techniques. The proposed system uses Transformer-based architectures such as BERT along with CNN and ResNet models for image analysis.
